'''''Scythis''''' was a [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

At some point the '''Scythis''' inspected a suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] arms cache protected by a [[Mine Type A|minefield]], with the help of an [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]]. Once the mines were cleared the Gunboat inspected the [[Class-D cargo container]] [[Pi (Class-D cargo container)|''Pi'']] to find it had a hanger and a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] ''[[Weet]]'' carrying Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] was launched. The transport was disabled and the patrol craft carrying [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] boarded and captured the transport.

The mission was recorded and recreated for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
